Nasenbluten was a hardcore/terror/breakbeat, otherwise self-proclaimed "cheapcore" act straight out of Newcastle, Australia. Made up of Mark Newlands (Overcast/Mark N), Aaron Lubinski (Xylocaine) and David Melo (Disassembler).  Most famous for their early & influential records on Industrial Strength Records. The English translation of the German word Nasenbluten is "nosebleed".
